# 📢 NH Reader v0.7.4 — Full Blacklist Grids & Polished Windows Installer

**Release Date:** 2026-10-06  
**Tag:** [`v0.7.4`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.7.4)

NH Reader v0.7.4 is a stability and installer-polish release. If you browse with the blacklist set to "Hide", this one is for you: filtered pages now backfill from upstream so every grid stays completely full, no matter how much you block. Windows installers also get a readable dark finish page, truly clean upgrades, and a Korean language build with zero warnings. As always, this is a source-only release — build and sign locally with your own credentials.

---

## 🌟 What's New in v0.7.4

### 🔍 Blacklist & Discovery
- **Always-full grids in Hide mode** — Previously, hiding many tags/languages/artists/categories filtered items client-side from fixed 28-item server pages, so pages could render nearly empty. NH Reader now streams upstream pages back (`streamBackfilledList`) until every page delivers its full 28 non-blacklisted galleries, buffering surplus items for seamless forward and backward navigation with zero empty slots.
- **Instant reaction to blacklist edits** — Adding, removing, or toggling blacklist modes bumps a reactive `blacklistVersion`, immediately re-streaming the grid so your changes take effect without a reload or navigation.

### 🪟 Windows Installer
- **Readable finish & welcome pages** — The installer's dark background previously left finish-page text in Windows default black — effectively invisible. Explicit color hooks now render titles, body text, and checkboxes in light tones on the dark surface.
- **Clean version upgrades** — Running the previous uninstaller without holding its process let it race the new install from `%TEMP%`. The installer now kills lingering processes and runs the old uninstaller synchronously, purging previous files completely before writing the new version.

### 🌐 Localization & Builds
- **Korean installer translations** — Full `MULTIUSER_INSTALLMODEPAGE` Korean strings ship in the NSIS hook, eliminating `MULTIUSER_TEXT_INSTALLMODE_TITLE` build warnings during `npm run build:app`.

### ⚙️ Project Health
- **GitHub Pages deployments fixed** — The Pages workflow now authenticates with a repository `PAT_TOKEN`, restoring cross-branch Pages deployments.
- **Tracking ledgers realigned** — `ROADMAP.md`, `TODO.md`, and `BUGS.md` were realigned to their canonical templates and a new `PLAN.md` sprint ledger added, so the repository's planning docs now show the full project history end to end.

---

## 🛠️ Manual Build & Signing

There are no prebuilt release assets. Build on each target platform and sign locally with your own certificate or key before distributing:

- **Windows:** `npm run build:app`, then `npm run sign:windows`. Place your PFX at `certificates/nh-reader-codesign.pfx`; the script can generate a local self-signed certificate if none exists, but self-signed certificates are not trusted publisher identities.
- **macOS:** `npm run build:app`, then `npm run sign:macos -- "<Developer ID Application identity>" "src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/NH Reader.app"`.
- **Linux:** `npm run build:app`, then `npm run sign:linux -- path/to/package`; verify with `gpg --verify path/to/package.asc path/to/package`.
- **Android:** `npm run mobile:android:init`, `npm run mobile:android:build`, then `npm run sign:android -- path/to/release.keystore --ks-key-alias <alias> path/to/app.apk`.
- **iOS:** From macOS with Xcode and a valid Apple signing identity/provisioning profile, run `npm run mobile:ios:init`, then `npm run sign:ios -- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<team-id> CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Apple Distribution" PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=<profile-name>`.

Signing credentials and provisioning profiles are user-managed and must not be committed. The project does not publish release assets.
